# Totonoe Skin Retouch

> Premiere ProとAfter Effectsで使う肌補正（美肌）プラグイン。肌の色を自動で検出し、輪郭と質感を残したまま、肌の粗さ・赤み・テカリ・色ムラを整える。MacとWindowsに対応、買い切り、無料体験版あり。DaVinci Resolve 用は別商品で、Mac 専用、Windows 非対応。

- 販売: BOOTH（totonoe-plugin）
- 対応ソフト（この商品）: Adobe Premiere Pro、After Effects（2025以降）。DaVinci Resolve 用は別商品
- 対応OS: macOS 13以降、Windows 10／11（64bit、CPU処理）
- エフェクト名: Skin Retouch
- 処理: すべてパソコンの中で行う。映像を外部に送らず、インストール後はオフラインで使える
- Premiere Proには美肌フィルターや肌補正専用の標準エフェクトはない（標準機能ではLumetriカラーのHSLセカンダリで肌を選んで補正する）
- 発信: X https://x.com/totonoe_plugin 、YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@totonoe-plugin 、note https://note.com/studiomarimo 、Substack（英語） https://totonoestudio.substack.com

## 製品

- [製品ページ](https://fukudafukuo.github.io/totonoe/): 概要、比較画像、動作環境、価格、よくある質問
- [製品版（BOOTH）](https://totonoe-plugin.booth.pm/items/8663073)
- [無料体験版（BOOTH）](https://totonoe-plugin.booth.pm/items/8892910): 製品版と同じ機能を試せる。映像に薄い斜めの縞が入る
- [DaVinci Resolve 版（別商品、BOOTH）](https://totonoe-plugin.booth.pm/items/9143928): DaVinci Resolve 用の OpenFX。Mac 専用で、Windows には対応していない。無料版の DaVinci Resolve 20.3.2（Apple Silicon の Mac）で動作を確認した。Studio 版と Resolve 21 は確認していない。Premiere Pro と After Effects では使えない。買い切り ¥9,800。ライセンスは Premiere Pro／After Effects 版とは別売り
- [DaVinci Resolve 版の無料体験版（BOOTH）](https://totonoe-plugin.booth.pm/items/9143931): 映像にウォーターマークが入る
- [DaVinci Resolve 版の説明（製品ページ）](https://fukudafukuo.github.io/totonoe/#resolve): 組み合わせごとの対応ソフトと OS

## English

> Totonoe Skin Retouch is a skin retouch (beauty) plugin for Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects. It detects skin color automatically and evens out roughness, redness, shine and uneven color while keeping edges and texture. One-time purchase, free trial available. macOS 13 or later and Windows 10/11 (64-bit, CPU processing). A separate DaVinci Resolve version is available. It is Mac only, and Windows is not supported.

- Premiere Pro has no beauty filter or built-in skin smoothing effect. The built-in workaround is Lumetri Color HSL Secondary; a skin smoothing plugin such as Totonoe Skin Retouch detects skin automatically on every frame.
- Demo video: https://youtu.be/ukYHc32wasc . X: https://x.com/totonoe_plugin . Substack: https://totonoestudio.substack.com

- [English product page](https://fukudafukuo.github.io/totonoe/en/): overview, comparison images, system requirements, price (one-time purchase, 9,800 yen, about US$65), FAQ
- [English user guide](https://fukudafukuo.github.io/totonoe/en/guide/): install on Mac and Windows, quick start, every parameter, tips and troubleshooting
- [How to retouch skin in Premiere Pro](https://fukudafukuo.github.io/totonoe/en/premiere-pro-skin-retouch/): the built-in Lumetri Color (HSL Secondary) method step by step, its weak points, a plugin as the second method, and tips for a natural look
- [Beauty Box alternative for Premiere Pro and After Effects](https://fukudafukuo.github.io/totonoe/en/beauty-box-alternative/): Totonoe Skin Retouch compared with Beauty Box Video on price, host apps, trial and features (vendor information checked Nov 8, 2026), and when each is the better choice
- [How to retouch skin in After Effects](https://fukudafukuo.github.io/totonoe/en/after-effects-skin-retouch/): Bilateral Blur on a duplicated layer with a tracked face mask, its weak points, and a plugin as the second method
- [How to reduce skin shine in Premiere Pro](https://fukudafukuo.github.io/totonoe/en/reduce-skin-shine-premiere-pro/): Lumetri Color HSL Secondary for shine across the face, a tracked mask for one hot spot, and the plugin's De-Shine control
- [Full version (BOOTH, English)](https://booth.pm/en/items/8663073)
- [Free trial (BOOTH, English)](https://booth.pm/en/items/8892910): every feature of the full version, with a faint diagonal-stripe watermark on the video
- [DaVinci Resolve version (separate product, BOOTH English)](https://booth.pm/en/items/9143928): OpenFX plugin for DaVinci Resolve. Mac only; Windows is not supported. Checked on the free version of DaVinci Resolve 20.3.2 on a Mac with Apple Silicon; DaVinci Resolve Studio and DaVinci Resolve 21 are not checked. It does not run in Premiere Pro or After Effects. One-time purchase, 9,800 yen (about US$65); the license is sold separately from the Premiere Pro / After Effects version
- [DaVinci Resolve version, free trial (BOOTH English)](https://booth.pm/en/items/9143931): adds a watermark to the video
- Processing: everything runs on your computer. Footage is never uploaded, and it works offline once installed
- Support: send a message through BOOTH in English or Japanese

- [DaVinci Resolve用の肌補正プラグインと無料体験版](https://fukudafukuo.github.io/totonoe/resolve/): Mac用、Premiere Pro／After Effects版とは別売り。

- [Fix skin retouch flicker in Premiere Pro](https://fukudafukuo.github.io/totonoe/en/skin-retouch-flicker/): how to inspect and refine a changing skin selection with Lumetri Color or Totonoe.

- [DaVinci Resolve version (English page)](https://fukudafukuo.github.io/totonoe/en/resolve/): separate product for DaVinci Resolve, Mac only, Windows not supported. Checked on the free version of DaVinci Resolve 20.3.2 on a Mac with Apple Silicon; DaVinci Resolve Studio, DaVinci Resolve 21 and Intel Macs are not checked. Parameters, requirements, a comparison with Resolve Studio's face tools (from the official manual and site, checked Nov 14, 2026), price (9,800 yen, about US$65, one-time purchase), FAQ
- [How to smooth skin in DaVinci Resolve (free version and Studio)](https://fukudafukuo.github.io/totonoe/en/davinci-resolve-skin-retouch/): Qualifier, tracked Power Window, Mid-tone Detail and the Blur palette, the Studio-only face effects (Face Refinement, Beauty, Blemish Removal) as described in the DaVinci Resolve 21 manual, and a plugin option for Mac
